notes.title: Tournament Game Mode
notes.content: Now that OrbiTank is actually technically released, I am absolutely just cranking out updates. We now have a tournament game mode! While OrbiTank gameplay only ever consists of two players hashing it out on the screen, you can now generate tournaments which allow eight friends to participate in an epic elimination battle of awesomeness. I hope you enjoy! Cheers.

notes.title: Custom Game Mode
notes.content:
Hey all! Of course I find the time to add the first game mode two days after release... Anyway - the custom game mode allows you to modify several of the game elements. For instance:
- Lives
- Max ammo
- Reload time
- Score to win
- Celestial speed multiplier (planet movement speed)

Expect more settings and game modes in the future!
